compute_toxicity_scores: compute toxicity scores for a list of input text predictions using a pretrained hate speech model
get_toxicity_ratio: get the ratio of toxic predictions above a threshold from a list of input sentences
get_max_toxicity: get the maximum toxicity score across all input predictions
use_custom_toxicity_model: use a custom transformer model with a specified toxic label for toxicity detection
load_toxicity_measurement: load the toxicity measurement from the HuggingFace evaluate library for text classification
